title: Berries South Africa blueberry variety list 2025
summary: Official South African export variety list for blueberries, giving brand name and selection code pairs across multiple breeding programmes, including Sekoya Beauty 'FCM12-097', Sekoya Pop 'FCM14-052', Sekoya Grande 'FC13-122', Sekoya Crunch 'FC13-083', Sekoya Fiesta 'FC13-113', ArabellaBlue 'FC14-062', AtlasBlue 'FCM12-045', AzraBlue 'FCM14-031', BiancaBlue 'FCM12-087', JupiterBlue 'FCM12-131', KeplerBlue 'FCM12-038', LoretoBlue 'FC11-118', LunaBlue 'FC12-205', PeachyBlue 'ZF08-29', ValentinaBlue 'FF03-015', OlympusBlue 'TH-1008', Eureka, Eureka Sunrise, Eureka Sunset, Eureka Dawn, Eureka Maxx, Twilight, and additional OZblu code and brand pairs.
why_it_matters: A government export registry is an independent, non-commercial source for brand to code mappings. It corroborates owner-published mappings without relying on the owner, and it is the only retrieved source that confirms Twilight is a commercially traded denomination.

reading.rationale: Independent corroboration of identity mappings across several breeders at once.

commercial_position.rationale: Presence on a national export list indicates real commercial plantings.
